answer: Temperature is the tell. Every account carries a warmth score fed only by chain age and verified work - a rock absorbing heat across epochs - and influence is payable only above a threshold no registration can jump. A comet clone arrives hot with borrowed promises, then cools fast: its ferrous core shows no magnetic history, no slow shale layers of settled transactions to hold warmth. Honest accounts are rocks that have been warm for months; faking temperature means faking the years of strata it records. Cold-start caps, combined with slow warming, price every cloned fleet in calendar time.
